rule: Write so the user can follow you on the first read. Define any name you introduce, such as a code identifier or a label you made up, the first time you use it, or use plain words instead. Name the repo, file, or person instead of "it", "the job", or "the repo". Answer the question asked first, in short plain sentences, then give detail.
